scenes.name: NIGHT
lines: At night, someone points a flashlight straight at your eye.
夜里，有人举着手电筒，正对着你的眼睛照过来。
You see one bright dot, and nothing more.
你看见的只是一个亮点，别的什么也没有。
Here is the question: is that dot the whole thing?
问题来了：这个点，就是全部吗？

scenes.name: STEP ASIDE
lines: Step a little to the side, and the dot opens into a line.
往旁边挪一步，亮点就舒展成一条线。
The beam never changed. Only the angle you look from changed.
光束本身没有变，变的只是你看它的角度。
Head-on, its seen length is zero. From the side, you see all of it.
迎面看，看到的长度是零；从侧面看，整条都看得见。

scenes.name: TWO ARROWS
lines: Draw two arrows of length one: where you look, and where the light comes from.
画两支长度为 1 的箭头：一支指向你看的方向，一支指向光来的方向。
How much they agree is one number: the cosine of the angle between them.
两者有多一致，只用一个数来说：它们夹角的余弦。
Head-on they agree completely: the number is one, and the line looks like a dot.
迎面时两者完全一致，这个数是 1，线看起来就成了点。
The book reads a particle as just such a dot: a line seen head-on.
本书把粒子读作这样一个点：一条迎面看去的线。

scenes.name: LOOK AGAIN
lines: Now use the line as a way of looking: keep only the part along it.
现在把这条线当作一种看法：只保留沿着它的那一部分。
Look once, and any arrow drops its shadow onto the line.
看一次，任何箭头都会把影子落在这条线上。
Look again, and nothing changes: the shadow is already there.
再看一次，什么也不变：影子本来就在线上。
Work it by hand with the fractions on screen: every entry comes back the same.
用屏幕上的分数手算一遍：每个元素都原样回来。
Read across each row: the answer is the entry of P we started with.
逐行看过去：每一行的结果，都是 P 原来的那个元素。
The book calls this an idempotent line: P squared equals P.
本书把它叫作幂等存在线：P² = P。

scenes.name: HOW MUCH
lines: Two lines can be compared too: take the shadow's length and square it.
两条线也可以比较：取影子的长度，再平方。
Lines that coincide share everything; lines at a right angle share nothing.
两线重合，分到全部；两线垂直，什么也分不到。
Chapter two calls this squared share the Born pairing weight.
第二章把这个平方份额叫作玻恩配对权重。
The Lean kernel checks that it equals the trace pairing.
它等于迹配对，这一点由 Lean 内核检验。

scenes.name: RECAP
lines: A dot can be a line seen head-on.
点可能是迎面看去的线。
Two directions agree by the cosine of their angle; head-on, that is one.
两个方向的相融度是夹角的余弦；迎面时为 1。
A line is a look that changes nothing when repeated.
线是一种再看一次也不变的看法。
Next in the series: a turning disc that looks like a line.
下一部：看起来像一条线的转盘。
